description: Find D365 objects structurally similar to the one you supply (same kind, similar method set, similar field set). Useful when you need a working reference implementation to copy from.

filterAotType.description: Optional: filter to a specific AOT type, e.g. 'AxTable', 'AxClass'. If not set, uses the same type as the source object.

objectName.description: Object name to find similar objects for, e.g. 'ALMERSftpConnectionTable', 'SalesTable'

name: find_similar_implementations
